text: The paper reports that when all agents use the same LLM, the judge consistently favours the negative side, which the authors believe drives MAD's gains since the affirmative side tends to err on complex tasks. When debaters use different LLMs, the judge prefers the side using the same LLM as itself, which the authors read as evidence that LLMs might not be fair judges.
title: LLM judge favours the negative side and the debater sharing its backbone model
